- Review available logs and crash data

bead create --title "Identify root cause of agent crash" --description "## Task

Analyze investigation findings to determine why the agent crashed.

## Scope
- Review crash patterns and signals
- Identify whether crash was due to resource limits, bugs, or external factors
- Determine if issue is reproducible or one-time occurrence

## Acceptance Criteria
- Root cause identified (resource limit, bug, external factor, etc.)

args.description: Create child bead 2: Identify root cause

args.command:
bead create --title "Implement fix for agent crash issue" --description "## Task

Implement the appropriate fix based on root cause analysis.

## Scope
- If resource limit: adjust limits or optimize resource usage
- If bug: fix the underlying code issue
- If external factor: add error handling or resilience
- Document the fix approach

## Acceptance Criteria
- Fix implemented and committed
- Fix documented with rationale
- No regressions introduced

## Depends On
Root cause identification complete
" --label split-child

bead create --title "Verify fix prevents agent crashes" --description "## Task

Test and validate that the fix resolves the crash issue.

## Scope
- Run agent with similar workload
- Monitor for crashes or instability
- Confirm resource usage is within limits
- Validate error handling works as expected

## Acceptance Criteria
- Agent runs successfully without crashes
- Resource usage stable and within limits
- Error handling validated
- Fix marked as complete

## Depends On
Fix implementation complete
" --label split-child
